scientific_task: Select metric weights for an AMP binary-classification benchmark.

metric_definitions.ACC: Overall accuracy; prevalence-sensitive in imbalanced tests.
metric_definitions.AUPRC: Threshold-free precision-recall ranking quality; primary imbalance-sensitive endpoint.
metric_definitions.AUROC: Threshold-free discrimination across FPR/TPR; can look optimistic under severe imbalance.
metric_definitions.BalancedAccuracy: Mean sensitivity and specificity; threshold-dependent class-balanced summary.
metric_definitions.BrierScore: Probability calibration and accuracy; lower is better.
metric_definitions.ECE: Expected calibration error; lower is better and binning-dependent.
metric_definitions.F1-Score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall at a frozen threshold.
metric_definitions.MCC: Correlation-like summary using all confusion-matrix cells; robust to imbalance.
metric_definitions.NPV: Reliability of negative calls; prevalence-dependent and relevant to exclusion decisions.
metric_definitions.Precision: Positive predictive value; controls experimental false-positive burden.
metric_definitions.Specificity: True-negative rate; controls non-AMP rejection at a frozen threshold.

literature_consensus.evidence_pool: 2365 papers, 304 evidence batches and 241 compact chunk summaries
claims: AUPRC is the primary endpoint for highly imbalanced AMP binary classification.
MCC uses TP/TN/FP/FN and is more robust than accuracy under class imbalance.
Recall limits missed AMP candidates; precision limits false candidates entering wet-lab screening.
ACC, specificity, AUROC, F1 and calibration metrics remain mandatory report dimensions even when not dominant ranking endpoints.
Thresholds should be selected on independent validation evidence and frozen before formal testing.
Homology leakage and dataset provenance remain unresolved gates for the three currently stored datasets.

caveat: Exploratory post-hoc benchmark; provenance, independence and homology gates remain pending.
